verification_gaps.summary: Failure-after-decision and controller-deletion lifecycle cases were missing from verification.
verification_gaps.evidence: Sequential/race coverage did not prove behavior after a later generation failure or deletion of a controller with decisions from other Runs.
verification_gaps.impact: A controller could become unreadable or a retained Signal could lose exact replay without detection.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Add dual-provider lifecycle, deletion and exact-replay fixtures.

plan_gaps.summary: A controller could be committed on a Run later marked failed.
plan_gaps.evidence: The current loop persists suggestions before terminalizing the Run; a later error marks the whole Run failed while investigation reads accept only successful terminal Runs.
plan_gaps.impact: Later Signals could be suppressed by an unreadable controller with no v1 release path.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Terminalize partial committed analysis as completed_with_errors and guard all decision inserts on the current Run remaining running.

plan_gaps.summary: Cascading controller deletion could erase decisions for retained suppressed Signals.
plan_gaps.evidence: Suppressed rows point to a Recommendation owned by another Run; cascading that Recommendation removes their per-Signal replay record.
plan_gaps.impact: A retained Signal could be silently undecided or remapped.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Restrict controller deletion while retained decisions depend on it, while preserving suppressed-Signal and whole-project deletion semantics.

plan_gaps.summary: Legacy adoption predicates and ordering were underspecified across providers.
plan_gaps.evidence: Loose same-page qualification, multiple Actions and default string collation could select different or noncanonical controllers.
plan_gaps.impact: D1 and PostgreSQL could suppress against different saved work or expose the wrong Action link.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Require the exact detector/template graph and Action key, explicit provider code-unit ordering and distinguishing parity fixtures.

do_not_change: Preserve the conservative v1 policy; do not infer material change or completed-work release in this foundation.
